format: UCWDC competitor conduct (future UCWDC body profile)

source.quote_free_summary: UCWDC reserves the right to exclude a competitor from an event for breaking an applicable law or its Associate Membership Code of Conduct, as determined at UCWDC's sole discretion.

requirement: The exclusion power belongs to UCWDC, not to the event organizer. A UCWDC profile must not let an organizer's 'Excluded (organizer decision)' stand in for it, and must define who may record a UCWDC exclusion.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: UCWDC profile. No DanceFlow action, status or workflow models it; the existing 'Excluded (organizer decision)' action (CF1 A5) is organizer policy and is never a substitute.
interpretation_notes: Re-read 2026-11-23: "sole discretion of the UCWDC". The power is reserved to UCWDC itself, so the entry is recorded as mandatory for a future UCWDC profile (it must reserve the power and let no organizer stand in); whether a dedicated rule class for body-reserved powers is wanted is an owner schema question.
